answer_1.quote: We propose to utilize rich conversational structures... for abstractive conversation summarization. ... We evaluate our model on a large-scale dialogue summary dataset SAMSum ...

answer_2.quote: We evaluated models with the standard metric ROUGE Score (with stemming), and reported ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L.

answer_4.quote: We also conducted human annotations to evaluate the extracted dialogue summaries... we asked human annotators on Amazon Mechanical Turk to rate each summary ... on the scale of [-2, 0, 2], where -2 means ... 2 means it was understandable and gave a concise overview of the text.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each summary on a three-point scale: -2 (poor/irrelevant), 0 (partial/some mistakes), 2 (understandable and concise overview).
